scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Strongly rational unitary vertex operator algebras and conformal nets” (preprints/Strongly-rational-unitary-vertex-operator-algebras-and-conformal-nets-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 280 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b5f09142bda3ec3d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let V be a simple unitary strongly rational vertex operator algebra over C. Then: (1) V has polynomial energy bounds and is CKLW-strongly local. The algebras (1.3) form an irreducible conformal net AV . (2) V is completely unitary: every simple grading-restricted module is unitarizable, and all canonical invariant Hermitian fusion forms are positive definite. (3) Every unitary grading-restricted finite-length module is strongly integrable, with the closed-field equality (1.4). (4) The net AV is completely rational. (5) After choosing invariant positive forms on the simple modules, the Carpi–Weiner–Xu functor gives a braided unitary tensor equivalence Rep(V ) ≃ Repu (V ) FV CWX − − − − − → Repf (AV ). The tensor structure and braiding on the right are Connes fusion and DHR braiding, with a common orientation convention for the circle.
